author: potuz
content: Hey, I've hit this problem on implementation now, not sure who to ask from vouch, perhaps <@737740104281489531> knows? the issue is what should the endpoint return for `execution_payload_value` when a beacon block is requested. I assume multi-CLs like Vouch would want to get the block that will pay the most, but how do we deal with bids that include trusted payments? are these added to the `execution_payload_value` or not?

author: potuz
content: What are clients doing for this?

author: serenita_io
content:
Related discussion here - https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/631#discussion_r3655399777 .
In my opinion it technically should include it - `execution_payload_value = bid.value + bid.execution_payment` (careful, one is in Gwei and the other in Wei).
If a client doesn't allow/support trusted bids, the calculation still works the same way, the `bid.execution_payment` part will just be zero, right?
